definitions.explanation: One of the Japanese syllabary writing systems, typically used for foreign words and emphasis.

examples.japanese: {片仮名|かたかな}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
{片仮名|かたかな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{片仮名|かたかな}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}きます→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: This word is written in katakana.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外国|がいこく}→外国：02868_gaikoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{片仮名|かたかな}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}きます→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: Foreign names are written in katakana.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦とき→とき：02918_toki⟧、⟦{平仮名|ひらがな}→ひらがな：02949_hiragana⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{片仮名|かたかな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ほう→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しかった→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, katakana was harder than hiragana.

notes:
One of the three Japanese writing systems. {片仮名|かたかな} characters are angular in shape, derived from parts of ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧. Also written as カタカナ in casual use.

FUNCTIONS:
- Foreign loanwords (⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧, ⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧)
- Onomatopoeia (⟦ガタガタ→ガタガタ：05274_gatagata⟧, ⟦ワンワン→ワンワン：05428_wanwan⟧)
- Emphasis (similar to italics in English)
- Scientific and technical names
- Company and brand names

JAPANESE SCRIPTS:
- ⟦{平仮名|ひらがな}→ひらがな：02949_hiragana⟧: hiragana (native Japanese words, grammar)
- {片仮名|かたかな}: katakana (loanwords, emphasis)
- ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧: kanji (Chinese characters)

USAGE:
The word {片|かた} means 'partial' or 'one of a pair,' distinguishing it from {平|ひら} (plain/ordinary) in ⟦{平仮名|ひらがな}→ひらがな：02949_hiragana⟧.
